title: helm: private values schema + init hooks + upgrade/rollback compat
author: Priya Nair
commits: b1f3c8a: validate: add JSON Schema for values.yaml (private) and bump chart version
c4d9ae2: helm: add templated init hooks and idempotent init-jobs with timeouts and backoff
d7a1b90: upgrade: add pre-upgrade validation hook and rollback compatibility for CRDs
e2f4b11: docs: document values schema, compatibility matrix and upgrade notes
description: Motivation: Our Private installer must be robust across upgrades and support both legacy and new users of the values schema. This PR introduces a formal JSON Schema for the helm values (values.schema.json) to validate user input at install/upgrade time, improves templating for init hooks and jobs to be idempotent and observable, and adds pre-upgrade validation + rollback compatibility shims for common CRD/key migrations. Changes: 1) values.schema.json: explicit types, defaulting rules and deprecation annotations for legacy keys; 2) templates/init-hooks.yaml and templates/init-jobs.yaml: consolidated init logic into a single templated include, added lockfile annotation and configurable timeout/backoff; 3) pre-upgrade hook (job) validates that existing CRs are compatible with target chart version and writes a compat-configmap to drive safe rollbacks; 4) compat/ values and templates to allow older clusters to continue to use legacy keys while emitting warnings; 5) Chart.yaml and README updated with upgrade notes and a compatibility matrix. Checklist: - [x] JSON Schema covers all top-level keys used by installer - [x] Init hooks are idempotent and have sensible defaults - [x] Pre-upgrade validation added and gated behind a values flag - [x] Compatibility layer preserves legacy behavior unless opt-in for migration - [x] Docs updated with upgrade/rollback steps and examples Related: references previous PRs pr-18902, pr-19321, pr-19730 and Linear ENG-2721 for rollout acceptance criteria. Testing: unit schema validation, helm template rendering, end-to-end dry-run against a CNCF conformance cluster and an upgrade run in our perf-canary infra.
review_comments: Alex Chen: overall looks solid, left a couple stylistic nits on the helpers.tpl and one question about the lock annotation TTL (should it be in seconds instead of ms?).

Diego Morales: please add an explicit test case for a failed pre-upgrade validation that shows rollback path; otherwise LGTM.
Priya Nair (author): added an e2e test in perf-canary showing validation failure and automatic rollback path; test artifacts and logs attached to the Linear ticket.
Rohit Patel: CI flaked on lint previously; re-ran and green. Approved.
Emma Johnson: noted doc wording for 'compatibility matrix' - suggested small Clarifications which were applied. Approved.
release_notes: Helm chart (redwood-private) adds values.json schema validation, idempotent init hooks, pre-upgrade validation job, and a compatibility layer to smooth upgrades and rollbacks. Operators should read README upgrade notes and run the provided validation job before large upgrades.
